Participant Information

Version v1.0

About this study

This study investigates how the placement and price of products in a campus convenience store influence food choices.

What you will do

You will browse a virtual campus shelf and choose the foods you want to buy (about 10–15 minutes). You may decide whether to submit a basket, or simply browse without buying.

Information we collect

Date of birth (to calculate age), gender, university, height, weight, waist circumference, and an optional questionnaire code. We do not collect your name or contact details.

Privacy

Research records use a random pseudonymous identifier and store no name. All data is used for academic research only and is accessible only to the research team.

Voluntary participation

Participation is entirely voluntary. You may withdraw at any time without any consequence.
